title: Regulator
description: Definition of Regulator under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: a body or any authority established under any other law for the time being in force
content.plain_language: an organization or authority set up by a law that is currently in effect
examples: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
